invention.ref: Bronze culinary knives are excavated at Shang sites such as Yinxu; Bronze Age Mediterranean kitchens widely use blades specifically for cutting meat and vegetables
invention.ref_zh: 殷墟等商代遗址出土青铜庖厨刀，地中海青铜时代厨房普遍出现专职切割肉类蔬菜的厨刃

mass_production.ref: Peter Henckels registers the Twin trademark with the Solingen Cutlers’ Guild in Germany, marking the start of guild-organized industrial mass production of professional kitchen knives
mass_production.ref_zh: 彼得·亨克斯在德国索林根刀具行会注册双立人标志，开启近代专业厨刀工业行会化量产

popularization.ref: Post-war stainless-steel rustproofing and hardening spread; Santoku knives combining Chinese and Western cutting practices and modern chef’s knives enter households worldwide
popularization.ref_zh: 战后不锈钢防锈淬火工艺普及，结合中西式切削习惯的三德刀与现代主厨刀进入全球万千家庭厨房

locations.place_label_zh: 中国河南安阳（殷墟铜庖厨刀）
locations.place_label_en: Anyang, Henan, China (Yinxu bronze culinary knife)

summary_zh: 从青铜时代各古文明厨房专用的切削铜刀，到 18 世纪索林根建立的工匠行会，再到现代不锈钢防锈工艺，菜刀历经数千年演化，始终是人类烹饪备料的核心工具。
summary_en: From Bronze Age kitchen blades through 18th-century Solingen craft guilds to modern rust-resistant stainless steel, kitchen knives have evolved for millennia as core food-preparation tools.
summary_ja: 青銅器時代の調理用刃物から、18世紀のゾーリンゲンの刃物職人組合、現代のステンレス製刃物へと、包丁は数千年にわたって発展し、調理の基本的な道具であり続けている。
